latest.author: damiantw
latest.text: Release 01.000.001 tagged @pogo-1x3 was your oot.o2r built by another application? That error is because animations used in the Kokiri Forest scene aren't in your o2r file. This version will build a fresh o2r file using an OOT ROM in the /data/soh directory after each update (if one is present). It also handles missing animations by writing to the error log instead of crashing outright and resolves the "vertex ring overflow" issue.
